page.notes: Right margin references were read from the scan and placed beside the lines they stand against; "Meffin. anthropolo." is uncertain and the word after "de-" is printed as "Sacrā de-" with a hyphen at the line end. The stray mark before "boni" is treated as ink, not a printed dot. "Fonsc." and "Vasq." are copied with plain s as required. The catchword "pro-" is printed at the foot right, and signature "E 3" at the foot centre. Left-edge bleed from the neighbouring page is omitted.
